observations: GTIN 8700216170345 is corroborated by dm and Mueller for Pantene Pro-V Miracles Hydra Glow Shampoo 250 ml.
Sodium Laureth Sulfate, Sodium Citrate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, and Sodium Xylenesulfonate create the main cleanser/base system.
Stearyl Alcohol, Cetyl Alcohol, Polyquaternium-6, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride, Trihydroxystearin, Panthenol, Sodium Hyaluronate, and Biotin form the care/shine claim context.
